selection_rule: The existing unique-selector oracle remains unchanged. Exactly two planned twin-boss multi-candidate rows below are the only proposed candidate rows. No substitutions, split moves, predicate relaxation, coordinate tie-breaker, grammar expansion, or additional rows are permitted after candidate production or audit begins.

selector_contract.measurement_convention: Use the existing output-coordinate frame and geometry-gate tolerance; candidate count is evaluated on the transient boss output before any dependent sketch or cut.

multi_candidate_control.permitted_action: stop as ambiguous before SketchCircle or CutCylinder

candidate_producer.admission_boundary: A future M29-002 output may not add an executable manifest, corpus/provider input, training input, runtime resource, or active case-library record without a later review and ADR.

preconditions: two rectangular bosses are disjoint, strictly contained in the base top face, and joined to the same base
both boss tops are planar, have +Z normal, and share the same maximum output Z within the recorded tolerance
no dependent sketch or cut is attempted after a multi-candidate result
semantic_invariants: one connected solid remains before selector evaluation
the unchanged predicate returns exactly two candidates for each twin-boss row
the multi-candidate path records ambiguous and creates no selected-face-dependent artifact
the unique oracle still returns exactly one candidate

geometry: existing geometry replay gates apply only to the unchanged unique oracle and any explicitly generated pre-selector base-plus-boss artifact
sequence: multi-candidate rows end at FailClosedAmbiguous and must not contain SketchCircle or CutCylinder
editability: boss-width mutation preserves two eligible faces; shared-height mutation preserves ambiguity; unequal-height mutation is a rejected out-of-scope perturbation, not a tie-breaker treatment
semantic: wrong-face injection is rejected before geometry success can be claimed
hash_stability: two clean-directory normalized STEP hashes for every planned candidate row
split_isolation: centered twin-boss template appears only in development and offset twin-boss template only in held_out; the existing unique oracle is reused as a fixed reference, not moved between splits

negative_controls.method: Attempt to bind one named twin-boss top after cardinality=2.
negative_controls.expected_result: reject with selector_ambiguity; no dependent operation is emitted.

negative_controls.method: Attempt to choose a candidate by unrecorded X/Y position or enumeration.
negative_controls.expected_result: reject with coordinate_only_support; no geometry pass may override the rejection.
